The attached stable variant is designed to connect directly to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36630]my farmhouse retexture mod[/url]﻿. [b]To enable the seamless transition shown in the screenshots, go to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36630]Castle Farmhouse mod’s[/url]﻿ Generic Config Menu and set [i]Enable Tweaks for Seamless Stable Addition[/i] to [i]true[/i].[/b]

[img width=516,height=60]https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXd6HwUkDKe9T72j3K8OwkkchjWiGLSa_4W8qdxEATFJSYxbbCiFzAX6RH54Ot_087I6DpSg6r6DvPtq_qbQFlVxxKq2YUOEmtv06kSFixiAUJ0imWrLY7-hbjWKL-e0vcY3nUencQ?key=SworC8vVRoJ2neaPIeQuwg[/img]

I’m planning to create more castle-themed redesigns for other farm buildings, next I plan to re-texture the coop. Feel free to share any ideas or requests for this series with me! 

 [img width=516,height=60]https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfx4ZGAK6-NlnOMmSuzzJXT6Nwte9CMkG7nA62LOETE_tiQ0jKtAySM5uGymSHbss7akgC8I_d9uXYOACnAWVzbFtZFAkiOSBuOU5wAaVrIexyR8YcEHDRusSq_SCFogrWRcqSDxg?key=SworC8vVRoJ2neaPIeQuwg[/img]

I started this series because I found myself excitedly checking through [url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/FlashShifter?gameId=1303&pk_vid=b8cc2fa761b328a61755051662c71015]Flashshifter[/url]﻿'s Patreon for news of SVE's Castle Village update/sequel mod, and I got the itch to create some castle-themed Stardew art, so here we are! S.O. to Flashshifter, their creativity is catching. I studied their art style and the color palettes from Lance's Highlands Outpost to design the castles.

 The horses in the screenshots are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20042]Elle's Cuter Horses[/url].﻿

Lastly, the flowers on the decorated version of the mod are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20139]HxW Tilesheets[/url]﻿, a gigantic thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/HimeTarts?gameId=1303]HimeTarts[/url]﻿ and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Wildflourmods?gameId=1303]Wildflour[/url]﻿ for their beautiful mods and for making their work available for the community to use.
